description:
### 🎨 Gboard Patches v4.3.0 — Frosted Glass FAQ, Navigation Bar Rendering & Custom Fork Suite

Official Morphe-compatible patch release bundle incorporating upstream v4.3.0 enhancements alongside our certified custom modifications:

#### 🚀 Upstream v4.3.0 Features & Fixes:
* **Frosted Glass FAQ Section:** Integrated in-settings FAQ guides addressing blur rendering prerequisites and Pixel input flickering.
* **Navigation Bar Transparency Fix:** Seamless navigation bar extension now supported on Android 15 and below, and properly handles narrower docked layouts (e.g. one-handed mode).
* **Software Rendering Crash Prevention:** Graceful fallback to theme background when RenderNode blur drawing fails (`Software rendering doesn't support drawRenderNode`).
* **Updated Setting Defaults:** English Up-Flick Uppercase set to off; Access Points menu style enabled by default.

#### 🌟 Exclusive Fork Features & Hardened Usability Enhancements:
* **Custom 3D Emoji Font (.ttf):** Direct in-app font importer and real-time Typeface rendering with Direct Boot fallback resilience.
* **Permanent Spacebar Cursor Trackpad:** Spacebar cursor movement enabled by default with bulletproof cached resilience across restarts and Phenotype background syncs.
* **Pixel Voice Typing & Rambler:** Universal Google Pixel Rambler offline voice typing enabled for English (US) and English (India), shielded against background official selector suppression.
* **AI Writing Tools Persistence:** Proofread, rewrite, and tone adjustment features permanently unlocked across all global locales and resilient to background sync wipes.
* **Material 3 Expressive UI:** Authentic high-chroma styling tokens, rounded panel customization, and seamless keyboard theming.
* **Morphe Manager Integration:** Full `.mpp` patch bundle compatibility with Morphe Manager custom patch sources.
